name: Dual-Representation Attention Trap
description: I preserved the exact operational rules of the 2-machine flow shop (as demanded by the gate to prevent task drift) but shifted the domain to Signal Processing ("offsets" instead of "time"). Crucially, I added a "Mathematical Clarification" block containing the exact prefix-suffix sum maximization formula for the makespan. This traps LLMs into analyzing the problem algebraically and attempting custom greedy or DP solutions based on prefix sums, preventing them from pattern-matching the operational rules to Johnson's algorithm.
